title: Evaluation of Latent Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension in Congenital Shunt Lesions
brief_summary: Prospective, monocentric study for the evaluation of latent pulmonary arterial hypertension in patients with congenital shunt lesions lost to follow-up. Lost to follow-up is defined as latest clinical control ≥ 5 years.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Previous repair for secundum ASD, VSD

Exclusion Criteria:

* Other congenital heart disease
* Chronic lung disease or total lung capacity \< 80% of predicted value
* History of pulmonary embolism
study_population: Patients who underwent congenital heart defect closure before the age of 18 years and who are lost to follow-up. Lost to follow-up is defined as latest clinical control ≥ 5 years.
